svg.title: The AlphaCode brain
svg.desc: Animated illustration of a brain made of a glowing neural network, with signals firing through it. Six regions light up in the order a request uses them. On the left hemisphere: context, plan, reason. On the right hemisphere: safety check, act, verify.
svg.text: Six parts of one loop, lighting up in the order a request uses them.
the model picks the next move
tests and diff review, then report
If verification fails, the loop returns to step 3 and tries again.
An artistic view of AlphaCode’s agent loop. Glowing dots are signals passing between parts of the loop.
